name: Sant Pere Sallavinera (Spain)
description: Red field with a white bend sinister and a yellow bend crossing at the centre, and a white lamb in the hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Sant Pere Sallavinera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
